# The Sleep Diagnostic & Treatment Centre (Nairobi Sleep Center)

> Specialist sleep laboratory and clinic in Lavington, Nairobi, Kenya, open since 2019. Diagnoses and treats sleep apnoea, snoring, insomnia, narcolepsy, restless legs syndrome and periodic limb movement disorder. Offers overnight sleep studies (polysomnography), CPAP therapy and equipment, CBT for insomnia, and ENT/airway care with sister clinic Nairobi ENT Clinic.
